gpu.memory_basis: full256-user four-source-layer translation may peak near20GiB from FP32 cache pairs and FP64 OLS views/design/centering;32GiB budget on45GiB A40

droidspeak.selection: for each num_layers choose one contiguous layer interval by minimum Current Exact logit MSE over first32 calibration users and fixed16 candidates; ties lexicographic

kv_translate.source_layer_selection: in-sample calibration-only single-source-layer same-head OLS; rank by mean R2 over heads and K/V, then fit final maps from all heads of each selected source layer

ours.shared_bias: delta_r = N*b; shared per-event offset scaled by retained history length
ours.shared_bias_response: delta_r = N*b + T*r; shared affine correction using actual native user-history response
ours.features: constant for shared_bias; constant and native r/N for shared_bias_response
ours.normalization: all fitted normalization and coefficients learned only on that budget subset
ours.teacher_access: Current rebuilt state and teacher reads only for the selected budget users
ours.interpretation: both branches use history length; the second additionally uses history content in native response r; no query, summary, UID feature, or per-evaluation-user teacher

measurement_plan: Time the fixed pilot with peak allocation and per-method throughput, then update runtime estimate before the full run; no evaluation-based method or budget selection
launch: Use detached tmux if measured runtime exceeds30minutes

compute_accounting.x: incremental compatibility arithmetic relative to common native reading
compute_accounting.denominator: one Current Exact cache rebuild for each of the10000 release snapshots; never rebuild per request
compute_accounting.numerator: K + sum of actual extra reading arithmetic over all scored E14 requests
compute_accounting.teacher_cost: charge Current teacher cache construction only; Parent cache is already present and common
compute_accounting.fitting_and_profiling: include shared calibration, fitting and interval/head profiling in K
compute_accounting.reading: charge correction or extra candidate processing for the actual per-user request counts
compute_accounting.snapshot_work: charge translation/replay once per user snapshot as applicable
compute_accounting.non_claim: arithmetic accounting is not an end-to-end runtime ratio
